items.title: pgbadger v13.3 has been released
items.summary: Antananarivo, Madagascar - November 03, 2026pgBadgerpgBadger is a PostgreSQL performance analyzer, built for speed withfully detailed reports based on your PostgreSQL log files.pgBadger 13.3 was released today, this is a maintenance release that fixesissues and applied patches reported by users since last release.Add scroll on legend and mouseover graphs when the list of item is > 10.Fix several issues when the --explode option is used.Add filter of remote logs in watch mode on the remote host to not    import all the log.Fix several issues with multiline statement in the log.Fix the same execution reported by both log_min_duration_statement    and auto_explain resulting in counted twice.Add copy of explain plan.Handle "Query Parameters: ..." from auto_explain plan.Fix wrong queries dropped when filtering with --dbuser.Use per-run names for temporary dblist and last parsed files to prevent    two pgbadger running at the same time to read the same files.For the complete list of changes, please checkout the release noteon https://github.com/darold/pgbadger/releasesLinks & CreditsI would like to thank all users who submitted patches and userswho reported bugs and feature requests, they are all citedthe ChangeLog file.pgBadger is an open project. Any contribution to build a better tool iswelcome. You just have to send your ideas, features requests or patchesusing the GitHub tools or directly to pgbadger@darold.net.Links :Download:  http://pgbadger.darold.net/Support: use GitHub report tool at https://github.com/darold/pgbadger/issues  or contact pgbadger@darold.net.For a complete list of commercial support near of your place take a lookat the PostgreSQL Professional Services page,they all do great job and most of them can help you.About pgBadger :pgBagder is a new generation log analyzer for PostgreSQL, created byGilles Darold (also author of ora2pg, the powerful migration tool).pgBadger is a fast and easy tool to analyze your SQL traffic and createHTML5 reports with dynamics graphs. pgBadger is the perfect tool tounderstand the behavior of your PostgreSQL servers and identify whichSQL queries need to be optimized.Docs, Download & Demo at http://pgbadger.darold.net/
